scope: Every current rejected source plus resolved exclusions from the same review; all current source IDs are enumerated by the companion parity reports.

exclusion.reason: The exact signed predicate requires a public path to a listening port and the historical handler requires ListeningPortVerified plus complete listener/target/route/ingress inventories. The available independently validated native model proves only a bounded direct IPv4 configuration allowance, with application_listening=unknown and all_paths_evaluated=false. Neither that positive witness nor its absence settles the old listener contract. PublicReachability assertions in legacy fixtures have no authoritative listener producer. Quarantine this exact historical contract while preserving lineage and keeping the active native configuration alternatives available. This is an unsupported evidence/semantics classification, not an owner-input requirement or a blanket claim that future AWS-native ELB/telemetry proofs are impossible.

residual_gaps: Customer-approved organizations, accounts, OUs, golden PCRs and least-access intent cannot be inferred from inventory. These checks can compare observed values when an authenticated customer criterion is supplied.
Exact public path to a listening port is unsupported by the archived historical contract; bounded direct IPv4 allowance is useful separate evidence.
Optional scanners inspect bounded content with real detection engines; absence of a finding is not exhaustive secret absence or credential validity. Configuration indicators remain narrower.

source_fingerprint_policy: Per-row file_sha256 preserves the original source-review capture. current_source_sha256 records the latest acceptance source separately; matching source lineage is not semantic equivalence. See latest-acceptance.json for current test receipts and limits.
